title: Friday 130329
wodRaw:
[CrossFit Games Open 13.4](http://games.crossfit.com/workouts/the-open/2013#tabs-4)  
  
Complete as many reps as possible in 7 minutes following the rep scheme below:  
135 pound Clean and jerk, 3 reps  
3 Toes-to-bar  
135 pound Clean and jerk, 6 reps  
6 Toes-to-bar  
135 pound Clean and jerk, 9 reps  
9 Toes-to-bar  
135 pound Clean and jerk, 12 reps  
12 Toes-to-bar  
135 pound Clean and jerk, 15 reps  
15 Toes-to-bar  
135 pound Clean and jerk, 18 reps  
18 Toes-to-bar...  
This is a timed workout. If you complete the round of 18, go on to 21. If you complete 21, go on to 24, etc.  
  
For a downloadable PDF of the workout, click [here](http://media.crossfit.com/games/pdf/CFOpen_13dot4_WorkoutInstructions_JdR2wS76zP_1240.pdf).
